name: renpy-uv-py314
description: Native C/C++ deps for building Ren'Py against uv-managed Python 3.14.4 on Windows. Mirrors the pkg-config requirements extracted from renpy/renpy@master setup.py.
$ffmpeg-overlay: ffmpeg uses an overlay port at vcpkg-overlay-ports/ffmpeg/ pulled from vcpkg HEAD (version 8.1.1). The baseline ffmpeg port (6.1.1) cannot install because msys2-file-5.45-1-x86_64 was delisted. The overlay's portfile only requests automake from MSYS2, sidestepping the dead package. Required when invoking vcpkg: --overlay-ports=apps/renpy-uv-py314/vcpkg-overlay-ports. Risk: 8.1.1 has API changes vs the 5/6-era ABI Ren'Py 8.5.2 was written for; renpy/src/ffmedia.c may need patching.
